summary_markdown: The discussion focused on network configuration and testing procedures. Initially, it was confirmed that the Bandera terminal sensors are set to Channel 1, while the Wi-Fi points operate on Channel 1 (2.4 GHz) and Channel 36 (5 GHz). Later, a proposal was made to test channel switching for the Bandera terminal using the same methodology as previously conducted in Dnipro. This involves sequentially testing all available channels.
decisions: The team agreed to consider testing channel switching for the Bandera terminal.
